source_title: FW Thorpe Plc Annual Report and Accounts for the year ended 30 June 2019
availability_evidence: Annual report page 68 states that the financial statements were approved by the Board on 18 October 2019; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Tough UK trading conditions and operational disruption reduced underlying operating profit 9.3% and slightly squeezed margins, although revenue rose 0.9%. Second-half orders recovered, operating cash increased to £21.6m, cash and short-term financial assets exceeded £57m, and the Group raised its dividend.
already_announced_exclusion: The Portsmouth factory closure and property disposal, together with their disclosed one-off costs and gain, occurred before cutoff and are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: The profit and margin setback is specific and material, but improving orders, strong operating cash, substantial liquid resources and dividend growth provide strong offsets.

source_title: FW Thorpe Plc Annual Report and Accounts for the year ended 30 June 2021
availability_evidence: Annual report page 84 states that the financial statements were approved by the Board on 5 October 2021; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: COVID-19, Brexit effects, component shortages and rising input costs created operational pressure. Nevertheless revenue rose 4.0%, operating profit 17.7%, operating cash 12.9% and earnings per share 18.5%; cash exceeded £52m, net current assets increased and the Group declared both a higher ordinary dividend and a special dividend.
already_announced_exclusion: The Lightronics fire recovery and its exceptional insurance item, plus the already-paid Lightronics and Famostar earn-out provisions, are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Broad external pressure is explicit, but strong profit, cash and earnings growth, record orders, a robust balance sheet and enhanced shareholder distributions dominate the evidence.

source_title: FW Thorpe Plc Annual Report and Accounts for the year ended 30 June 2023
availability_evidence: Annual report page 112 states that the financial statements were approved by the Board on 12 October 2023; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Inflationary material, labour and operating costs pressured margins in selected businesses, but supply conditions and service levels normalised. Revenue rose 23%, operating profit 13%, operating cash 61% and earnings per share 9%; like-for-like revenue and operating profit also grew, cash remained strong and the dividend increased.
already_announced_exclusion: The strengthened TRT board and integration of the already-acquired Zemper and SchahlLED businesses disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Cost and margin pressure is identifiable but is outweighed by broad organic growth, sharply stronger operating cash, a strong cash balance and improving supply conditions.
